comparison.objective: Pack two eggs into carton cups small-end down; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile-object orientation and gentle cup placement versus bimanual long-rail support, spring-prong insertion, telescoping, and screw driving.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both eggs correctly oriented, centered, resting, and released; candidate requires correct rail orientation, four engaged prongs, matched rack units, screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: The egg task tests damage-sensitive placement, not mechanical latching or structural installation.
